issues.description: The UML in the problem statement defines the Lecture attributes as private (indicated by '-' in the UML), and the solution implements them as private fields. However, the template repository already declares two of these fields (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) as public. This visibility mismatch can confuse students: they may assume the provided public fields are final or complete, leading to duplicate declarations or incorrect visibility compared to the UML and tests that expect encapsulation and getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template so the pre-declared fields match the intended visibility in the UML: change the existing public fields to private (or remove them and leave only TODO placeholders). Ensure the template does not provide public attribute implementations that contradict the UML and the solution; this lets students add the private attributes and implement getters/setters as intended.
